role: Thread-safe frame buffer and observation session lifecycle management for Layer 2 perception pipeline.
detail: FrameBuffer: single-slot thread-safe frame buffer with drop-oldest policy. Capture thread puts frames at camera fps, processing loop gets at its own rate (e.g., 15 fps capture vs 3 fps processing); only most recent frame retained. Uses threading.Lock for frame slot protection and two threading.Events (_new_frame_event for frame availability, _stop_event for shutdown signal). get() method with configurable timeout (default 1.0s) returns None on timeout or stop; put() method stores frame and signals availability; stop() method idempotently halts consumers. ObservationSessionManager: async wrapper managing Layer 3 ObservationSession lifecycle (start_session creates node with UUID, end_session closes with timestamp). Defers circular import of layer3 functions to runtime via local imports inside methods.
gotchas: D-TS-13 stop protocol: get() returns None on stop signal even if frame available; circular import from layer2->layer3 resolved by runtime import inside start_session/end_session; get() may return same frame multiple times if processing is slower than capture (frame_sequence comparison needed to detect new vs stale); get() clears event before acquiring lock, so rapid put-get cycles may miss intermediate frames.
